notes.title: Chapter 2 of The Pilgrim’s Progress Arrives Soon!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45082156/e0ecf5c46e0670bae18f77ef1a2da28086cb7a41.png[/img]

Hello, Pilgrims!

We’re thrilled to announce that Chapter 2 of The Pilgrim’s Progress will be released as a FREE update in just a few weeks! This exciting update continues Christian’s journey as he ventures into the treacherous Swamp of Despond. Prepare to navigate perilous terrain, face new challenges, and experience the next chapter of this epic pilgrimage.

Since the game launched with Chapter 1, your incredible support has encouraged us to keep building this world. If you haven’t started the journey yet, now is the perfect time to experience Chapter 1 and get ready for what’s to come!

[b]What Awaits You in Chapter 2?[/b]
🌟 A Free Update – Chapter 2 will be automatically added to the game for all players at no extra cost.
🌿 Enter the Swamp of Despond – Navigate a haunting new area filled with dangerous terrain and hidden secrets.
⚔️ New Challenges and Enemies – Test your skills against swamp-themed foes with unique abilities.
🎵 Expanded Lore and Atmosphere – Dive deeper into Christian’s story with immersive music, dialogues, and visuals.

[b]When Will It Be Available?[/b]
We’re putting the final touches on Chapter 2 and aim to release it in just a few weeks. Keep an eye on this page for the exact release date!

notes.title: First Release
notes.content:
📢 Countdown to The Pilgrim's Progress Release – Chapter 1 Arrives December 2nd! 📢

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45082156/c1f6b7c0aa380f490b19c4ffe8a93b6171acc457.jpg[/img]

Hello, Travelers!

We’re thrilled to announce that The Pilgrim's Progress will officially launch on December 2nd! The journey begins with the release of our first chapter, inviting you to take your first steps toward the Celestial City.

What Awaits You:
In this opening chapter, you’ll embark on a challenging pilgrimage through an unfamiliar and treacherous world. Encounter foes, overcome trials, and uncover messages of hope and faith that will guide you forward. This chapter marks the start of an epic journey, and we’re excited to have you along for it!

More Chapters – No Extra Charges!
The story doesn’t end here. We’re planning six more chapters, which will all be released as free updates — not DLC. That’s right: each chapter will be added to your game at no additional cost. We’re committed to delivering a complete experience to everyone who joins us on this journey, without extra charges along the way.

Thank you for your support, and for being part of our community. The journey to the Celestial City begins soon, and we can’t wait for you to be a part of it!

With gratitude,
The Pilgrim's Progress Team

notes.title: How To Play
notes.content:
[h1]How to play?[/h1]

This game revolves around the concept of faith. 

As you hit an enemy, your faith increases, symbolizing your growing spiritual strength. 
Conversely, when you get hit, your faith decreases, reflecting the challenges you face. 
Over time, your faith naturally diminishes, requiring constant vigilance. 
As you progress through each chapter, the rate at which your faith decreases accelerates, adding to the challenge. 

The damage you inflict on enemies is proportional to your current level of faith, emphasizing its crucial role in combat effectiveness. 

When you reach the next level of faith, you level up, and your maximum health increases, allowing you to endure more in your journey. 

This dynamic system ensures that maintaining and growing your faith is key to your success in the game.

notes.title: Demo Version of The Pilgrim's Progress Releasing Soon!
notes.content:

After months of hard work and dedication, our team has crafted an immersive experience that we can't wait to share with you. The demo will give you a sneak peek into the world we've built, starting with the first chapter of our epic journey.
